value: Updated the connected scatterplot with three fixes: (1) Added a per-city 'line-color' COLOR instance parameter so each city's line/dot color is controllable individually. (2) Added a 'label' TEXT instance parameter linked to city names, so the legend now shows real city names instead of 'City 1, City 2'. (3) Added global 'legend-text-color' and 'legend-text-size' parameters to control the legend text styling. The data table now includes 'city_name' and 'city_color' columns that are linked to the visualization parameters.
